name: Anthony Todaro
tagline: Top rated Business Litigation attorney in Seattle, Washington
about: Anthony Todaro is a top-rated attorney practicing in the Seattle, Washington area. Providing legal representation in Washington for a variety of different issues, Anthony Todaro was selected to Super Lawyers for 2015 - 2026.

After completing undergraduate studies, Anthony Todaro attended law school. Anthony Todaro was enrolled at Northwestern University School of Law. He earned a juris doctor degree in 2000. Anthony Todaro was admitted to the practice of law in 2000.

Attorneys like Anthony Todaro are recognized by their peers for their outstanding work and commitment to the spirit of the legal profession. Their knowledge of the law, professional work ethic, and advocacy on behalf of their clients allow them to stand out among other attorneys in the field.
Anthony Todaro represents clients with Business Litigation issues. Additional legal issues represented include Civil Litigation: Defense.
